name: mcp_server
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk MCP (Model Context Protocol) server registration — a tool/data provider that AI agents can connect to over HTTP, SSE, or a raw configuration.

attributes.name: config_type
attributes.description: Configuration type. 'Http' and 'Sse' connect to a remote server at api_endpoint; 'Raw' uses raw_config. Defaults to 'Http'.

attributes.name: api_endpoint
attributes.description: Absolute URL of the MCP server. Required when config_type is 'Http' or 'Sse'; must be a well-formed absolute URL.

attributes.name: transport
attributes.description: Transport used to reach the server (e.g. 'http', 'sse'). Required when config_type is 'Http' or 'Sse'.

attributes.name: raw_config
attributes.description: Raw key/value configuration. Required when config_type is 'Raw', and must be omitted for 'Http'/'Sse'. Holds flat string values only — nested structures are not supported via this attribute.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Whether the MCP server is active and available for use. Defaults to active when omitted.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the server was created (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the server was last updated (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version counter, incremented on each update.
